name: embed-providers
title: Embed Providers
description: The video hosts a document may embed — YouTube and Loom: matchEmbed reads a URL's provider and video id (YouTube's start time too), each provider rebuilds its player src from the id alone, and EMBED_FRAME_ORIGINS is the frame-src allowlist. Pure, server-safe.

meta.whenToUse: Deciding whether a URL is an embeddable video (YouTube, Loom) and building its player src — in TextEdit, MarkdownView, a server import, or a Content-Security-Policy's frame-src.
meta.whenNotToUse: Any other host: the allowlist is the security boundary; add a provider here, never a raw URL as a frame src.
